declarations.semanticEquivalent: The Python union alias selects ImageDocument, VideoDocument, AudioDocument or BinaryDocument from the Rust enum variant. Runtime classification stays in Rust; Python does not inspect signatures or decode media.

Both factories retain the exact input bytes and use signature classification. Recognized image, video and audio types select their concrete variant; other inputs remain binary. Python omits payload bytes from repr and model dumps, while the native handle owns them.
Both operations read one bounded regular file, retain only its basename as filename metadata, and return the Rust-classified concrete file type. Python awaits the native Rust filesystem operation.
The byte limit uses the same units, a 64 MiB default, and a 256 MiB hard maximum. Python validates authoring fields and Rust revalidates limits at operation time.

Filename, declared MIME, detected MIME and provenance remain separate fields. Source values preserve exact URLs up to a 1 MiB UTF-8 bound; other caller metadata retains its smaller field bounds. Rust computes detection and SHA-256 from the exact payload.

Both operations classify only a complete retained Direct HTTP body, reuse Rust-owned bytes, perform no second request, and preserve HTTP status and the original response body. Missing or incomplete bodies keep the typed BodyUnavailable error.

Concrete Rust media types produce their exact typed Archive reference. Python runtime dispatch returns ImageDocumentArchiveRef, VideoDocumentArchiveRef, AudioDocumentArchiveRef or BinaryDocumentArchiveRef without erasing the stored variant.
A typed Rust media Archive reference restores its matching concrete file type with the same identity, metadata and exact bytes. Cross-kind references fail typed validation.
Python raises a dedicated exception and rust_error_details preserves the Rust error variant and structured payload, including size, type mismatch and unavailable-body outcomes.
Python returns a context manager bound to the existing Work owner. Entry arms capture before returning; the caller runs its own Flow or action, and no click is synthesized or retried.
Both operations await one completed bounded file and preserve the Rust concrete type. Python task cancellation signals native cancellation and waits for provider cleanup before leaving the context.
Leaving an unconsumed Python download context explicitly awaits native cancellation and browser-context restoration. Cleanup errors remain visible beside an active body exception.

Python preserves typed engine, timeout, size, cancellation, provider, cleanup, unrelated-download and nested FileDocument failures through rust_error_details, including any retained recovery-directory path.
